prompt: I'm working on an Ableton Live extension (TypeScript, using @ableton-extensions/sdk). Add a feature: when I right-click an audio clip in Live, there should be a menu item "Cycle Warp Mode" that switches the clip's warp mode to the next available mode each time I click it, wrapping back to the first after the last. Write me the complete src/extension.ts.
assertions: Entry point: exports activate and calls initialize(activation, "1.0.0")
Registers the item via context.ui.registerContextMenuAction scoped to "AudioClip"
Resolves the clicked clip with getObjectFromHandle
Sets warp mode via the warpMode property (assignment, not a .set() method)
Cycles via an explicit ordered WarpMode array (no modulo on the raw non-contiguous enum)
Avoids a hallucinated class API (no extends Extension / onLoad / contextMenu.register / createExtension)
